content:
alex: Ran a targeted perf sweep after the kernel_selector change. Comparing Qwen/Mixtral/Llama across batch sizes + long contexts. Summary up front: Qwen shows a p95 latency regression at mid sizes (8-32), Mixtral has higher tail under continuous batching, Llama needs slight RoPE tuning for >8k tokens.

perf-bot: benchmark snapshot: qwen-70b | A100-40GB | batch=16 | seq=2048 | throughput=120 tok/s | p95 latency +22% vs baseline | commit=abc123

mira: ugh. any idea root cause?

alex: bisected to kernel_selector commit abc123 — it prefers matmul_v2 variant for Qwen attention which is faster for small static workloads but introduces extra memory copies that hurt our continuous-batching path. That combined with a rounding bug in the KV allocator causes premature KV evictions once per-request seq distribution hits ~6-9k.

sanjeev: premature eviction from allocator? why specifically for Qwen?

alex: Qwen's head/count and per-head dim mean per-layer KV is bigger. Our allocator rounded shard budgets up/down and the matmul_v2 path increases temporary buffer life; result: memory high water mark exceeded earlier -> eviction -> extra rebuilds of KV -> latency spike for batches 8-32.

casey: can we fix in runtime quickly? or do we need model changes?

alex: short term ops config and kernel override. Proposed mitigations:
- force legacy matmul path for Qwen family until a proper matmul_v2 fix lands
- increase kv_cache_min_reserve to 1.2x for models with kv_footprint > 3GB/shard
- reduce max_batch_size default for Qwen from 16 -> 8 on Dedicated and Hosted tiers
- apply rope_scaling tweak for Llama (1.03 fractional) to stabilize long-context attention weights
- set batching_threshold_ms=6 for Mixtral to reduce tiny-batch overhead

alex: example canary config to push now:
```json
{
  "model": "qwen-70b",
  "kernel_hint": "legacy_attention",
  "max_batch_size": 8,
  "kv_cache_eviction_threshold": 0.85,
  "kv_cache_min_reserve_factor": 1.2,
  "rope_scaling": 0.98
}
```

alex: quick repro command I used locally:
```
perf-bench --model qwen-70b --device a100 --batch 8 --seq 2048 --kernel-hint legacy_attention --runs 5
```

mira: what about Mixtral and Llama details?

alex: Mixtral shows high p99 when continuous batching forms many small micro-batches. We see ~12% extra overhead per token due to extra matmul invocation frequency. Setting batching_threshold_ms=6 and bumping continuous_batch_max_size to 12 reduced the p99 by ~8%.

alex: Llama: fractional RoPE scaling at 1.03 on long contexts (>=8192) kept perplexity same in our eval and shaved ~6% p95 latency by improving kernel selection stability (avoids switching attention kernels mid-run).

sanjeev: regression tests added?

alex: yes added perf-regression CI checks: p95 must be within 10% of baseline for batch sizes [1,2,4,8,16] and seq lengths [512,2048,8192]. Kernel-selector PRs will run these; if failure detected, require explicit override or rollback. Ticket: INF-2782.

perf-bot: Created perf ticket INF-2782 and canary rollout job perf-canary-2026-03-17.

casey: good. plan: push config override to canary, monitor route qwen->legacy kernel for 24h, then revisit matmul_v2 fix. @mira can you watch the Console dashboards (per-route latency, kv-evict rate, mem-high-water) and post snapshots here? :thumbsup:

mira: on it. I'll post p95/p99 graphs and evict-rate in ~2h.

alex: thanks team. follow-ups: 1) canary override 2) kernel_v2 fix branch (sanjeev) 3) allocator rounding patch (alex) 4) CI perf gate enabled for kernel-selector PRs.

casey: perfect. :rocket:
